text:
maya: FYI we've got a spike in EU aggregate recomputes — a bunch of late events landed overnight and the console is showing 6h stale for a couple customers. Thinking we should do a quick reslice and run small bursts to the priority lane. any objections? :thinking:

raj: can you paste the query that shows the staleness? i want to confirm it's not just the dashboard cache.

maya: query from console debug panel: `SELECT hour, count(*) FROM agg_hours WHERE processed_at < window_start - interval '6 hours' AND region='eu'` — shows ~1.8M rows across 32 shards. dashboard cache TTL is 5m, so not that.

olivia: 1.8M over 32 shards = ~56k rows/shard, should be ok if we do controlled bursts. what's the target freshness SLA we aim for here?

maya: target is <1h for affected metrics (SLO is 2h but customers flagged regression). plan: reslice into 1h slices, mark high-priority tenants, run 4 concurrent workers per shard limited to 60qps, and route to dedicated priority lane to avoid impacting normal backfills.

sam: sounds reasonable. two asks: (1) make sure the resume/abort hooks are safe for partial window commits; last time a worker crashed and left a half-written shard. (2) add a console flag to show 'reslice in progress' so PM/support don't toggle things.

maya: yes on (1) — we'll use the idempotent commit protocol (same as replay v2). i'll add a flag in console (ui:reslice_eu_2026_03_19) and a short note in the replay ticket.

raj: operational question: if priority lane saturates, do we fallback to queueing in normal lane or throttle? i'd prefer throttle and keep normal API unaffected.

olivia: throttle. customers on normal paths must keep their SLO. we can set a soft cap of 70% lane utilization and start shedding low-priority slices when we hit 80%.

maya: agreed. I'll set `max_util=0.7` and `shed_at=0.8` for the job. Also adding a pulse alarm to #eng-sre to notify at 65% so they can watch.

replay-bot: Job scheduled: `/replay start --mode reslice --region eu --slice-size 1h --shards 32 --workers-per-shard 4 --priority high --max-util 0.7 --shed-at 0.8` (job id: rpl-20260319-89a)

sam: please add a small smoke check after the first 2 slices to validate counts and duplicates. last time we had a duplicate join bug.

maya: good call. will run `count_diff` smoke check script after slices 0..1 and post results here. if diff > 0.5% we pause and roll back.

raj: thanks — ping me when you've posted the smoke results. i'm on standby for scaling up if needed. :thumbsup:

maya: ok kicking off in 3m. posting initial smoke output in thread once available. :rocket:
